name: JSON Preview
description: Tree-style JSON preview with a compact action bar for folding, JSONPath and metadata, a clean monospace tree with gutter fold markers, syntax colors, error locations, duplicate-key hints, JSON Lines support and format/minify/validate commands. Refreshes while you edit; requires a plugin API v2 host (v1 hosts are not supported).

versions.release_notes: Rewritten for plugin API v2; v1 hosts cannot install or activate it. The single-file main.lua is split into json.parser, display, path, tree and meta modules loaded via sandboxed require. Folding becomes per-node: every container line carries its fold path as command args, and folding refreshes the panel in place with luban.panel.refresh, preserving scroll position; Ctrl+Alt+J stays as the cursor-based keyboard path. Fold state uses in-memory exact structural paths with a state.json fallback in the plugin data directory, which adds the filesystem permission. on_edit invalidates fold state when the root structure changes; header action buttons become the only form.

Matches compact JSON viewer styling: borderless monospace tree lines, fold triangles in the indent gutter, key alignment with scalar siblings, a file-and-root summary in the panel title and no duplicate summary line. On hosts with panel API v2, Fold All/Expand All, JSONPath and Metadata become flat header actions that keep the panel scroll position; older hosts keep the three in-content fallback rows.

Moves node folding, JSONPath and metadata into three clickable action rows at the top of the preview panel. The Folding row toggles between Fold All and Expand All, JSONPath shows the path at the cursor or extracts the selected expression, and Metadata opens the inspector. These commands are no longer contributed to the Plugins menu; they remain available from the command palette and keyboard shortcuts.

Adds node folding (Toggle Fold at the cursor, Fold All, Expand All and an initial fold level), JSONPath display and extraction in the inspector, and JSON metadata analysis (type counts, depth, duplicate keys, string and number statistics). JSON Lines supports folding, JSONPath and metadata. Fold state survives edits and automatic refreshes.
Fix Format Document and Minify Document when the cursor is near the end of a document that becomes shorter: the host selection is now explicitly reset to the document start.

Initial release. Strict RFC 8259 parser with key order and duplicate keys preserved, tree preview with theme colors, error line/column with source context and caret, duplicate-key hints, JSON Lines detection, and JSON Preview / Format / Minify / Validate commands. Refreshes while you edit on 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts render the plain-text fallback and refresh manually.

zh-CN.name: JSON 预览
zh-CN.description: 在右侧面板以树状结构预览 JSON，采用紧凑等宽树形样式和缩进槽折叠三角，标题栏提供折叠、JSONPath 和元数据操作，并支持语法配色、错误行列定位、重复键提示、JSON Lines 自动识别，以及格式化、压缩和校验命令。随编辑自动刷新；需要插件 API v2 宿主，不再支持 v1 宿主。
